Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 6 about acquisitions; 2 about growth or hiring; 1 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.

insights.one_liner: US biopharma giant with Dutch finance and operations roles in Zwolle and Hoofddorp, describing an informal, international workplace.

culture.text: A global biopharma company of about 60,310 staff, working in immunology, oncology, neuroscience and aesthetics.
Its Financial Analyst role describes an informal atmosphere and international environment that suits open-minded people.
Current jobs here are in finance (Zwolle) and operations (Hoofddorp).

open.text: IND recognised visa sponsor (AbbVie B.V., AbbVie Central Finance and AbbVie Finance).
All 3 current jobs here don't require Dutch; 1 of 3 mentions visa or relocation support.

growth.text: Revenue was USD 58.054 billion in 2022, with a net profit of USD 11.836 billion.
Won FDA approval for Parkinson's pill Juvmo, from its USD 8.7 billion Cerevel takeover.

worth_knowing.text: Its lymphoma drug Epkinly, developed with Genmab, cut progression or death risk by 51% in a Phase 3 trial.
Joined a US government pilot testing drug discount rebates.
